source_title: Samsung Announces Operation of its Memory Facility in Xi’an, China
claim_relevant_visible_text: Samsung Electronics announced that its memory fabrication line in Xi’an China has begun full-scale manufacturing operations. The new facility will manufacture Samsung’s advanced NAND flash memory chips: 3D V-NAND.
researcher_paraphrase: Samsung established Xi’an as an operating NAND/V-NAND fabrication site, giving a concrete installed-fab counterpart to later export-authorization changes.
precision_guard: This proves operation and product type at the 2014 vintage. It does not establish 2022-2025 capacity, layer count, technology node or the magnitude of later policy effects.
authority_boundary: Samsung is primary for the operating status and intended product of its own Xi’an memory facility.
